EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460),
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
ACT (AMENDMENT) NO. 28 OF 1964
Acquisition of land for the Improvement of 20 km of
Demodara- Springvalley-Badulla Road
Notice under Section 07

I, hereby give notice, to the public under Sub section (1) of Section (7) of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by Land Acquisition Act (amendment) No. 28 of 1964, the land/servitude described below is required by the Government and the Government intends to acquire the said land/servitude for public purpose :-

Description of the land for servitude to be acquired: The Schedule - 01 including blocks of lands and boundaries described below of 0.5790 hectares in extent in the Page No. 57, Supplement No. 61 of Final Village Plan No. 80 dated 30.11.2017, prepared by Badulla District Senior Superintendent of Survey for the Survey General, situated in Hindagoda Village (within Badulla Municipality) of Hangwella Division No. 15 of 78K Hindagoda Grama Niladhari Division, coming under Rilpola Korale Minor Division in Badulla Divisional Secretary Division of Badulla District in the Province of Uva.
